507.DSCR:
Commander of $$ジェミニス$$, a special unit belonging to $$サイデリアル$$.

He is also the strongest warrior among the $$ジェミナイド$$s, and like the other $$ジェミニス$$ members he fights by channeling psychokinetic power directly into his unit's controls, though his own strength is on an entirely different level even within $$ジェミニス$$.

530.DSCR:
First Prince of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$. 24 years old.
The biological son of the late king, $$キング$$ $$インサラウム$$ the 72nd; he had not yet been enthroned, but after the death of the 72nd he was to become the ruler of $$インサラウム$$.
Gentle, thoughtful and full of compassion, he was beloved by the people. But he also had a timid side, and after the destruction of $$インサラウム$$ he allowed $$アンブローン$$, who took office as Prime Minister, to seize control.
He has studied the martial arts to a fair degree, but, ability aside, his natural gentleness makes him unsuited to real combat.
His hobby was reading poetry, and he also served as an honorary adviser to the Arts Agency of $$インサラウム$$.
The death of his trusted vassal $$ジェラウド$$ awakened him to his mission, and he devoted everything to the future of $$インサラウム$$.
That love awakened the $$スフィア$$ of the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$ mounted on $$聖王機ジ・インサー$$, handed down in $$インサラウム$$.
In the end he lost the decisive battle at the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on Mars, and the $$スフィア$$ of the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$ was taken by $$アサキム$$, but his will was inherited by the people of $$インサラウム$$, beginning with $$マルグリット$$, and he is revered even more than in life as the last Holy $$キング$$.

531.DSCR:
The holder of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, who pilots the mobile weapon $$アリエティス$$.
In order to bring chaos to the world, he summoned $$ガイオウ$$, the $$破界の王$$, and worked in the shadows as strategist of the $$新帝国インペリウム$$.
At the end of the $$破界事変$$ he was thought to have been killed in the battle in Antarctica, but that death was a disguise created by the power of the $$スフィア$$.
For his own purposes, he provided dimensional science to $$アンブローン$$ of $$インサラウム$$. Much of his intent is unknown, but it seems there is something more behind the linking of the two parallel worlds than hunting other $$スフィア$$ holders.
The $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$ governs human lies, and its holder's words and deeds are likewise full of lies, making it hard to grasp his true feelings. Moreover, having been half absorbed by the $$スフィア$$, when his emotions rise he becomes unable to say what is correct, that is, what has meaning.
In the $$再世戦争$$, the $$スフィア$$ was taken from him by $$ユーサー・インサラウム$$, and he died.

532.DSCR:
Number 3 of the $$アークセイバー$$ of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$. 46 years old.

A strict man with a strong sense of duty, he was praised as a model of knighthood, and because of his skill in the martial arts he was also a mentor to the younger junior knights. Although his favorite pupil $$ウェイン$$'s misconduct gave him a great deal of trouble, he always kept watching over him.
In the world where the $$破界の王$$ appeared he was defeated in battle, swore absolute obedience to him and to his close aide $$アイム#pilot$$, and came to put his own self-preservation first. But all of this was meant to deceive the eyes of $$ガイオウ$$ and $$アイム#pilot$$; hoping for the restoration of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$, he had deliberately shown an attitude of submission in order to gather information on them.

533.DSCR:
Number 1 of the $$アークセイバー$$ of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$. 35 years old.

A man who excels in courtesy, education and martial arts alike, he commanded the respect of all knights. He was also the strongest of the $$アークセイバー$$ in bare-handed combat, and was on a three-time winning streak at the $$御前武闘会$$ held once every two years. Incidentally, the 'Gallus' in his name is a title given to the winner of the $$御前武闘会$$.
He was the very picture of plain, sturdy strength, but on the battlefield he fought more bravely and fiercely than anyone, and inside he was full of a knight's fighting spirit and pride.
Because of that strength, he was even called the strongest in the history of $$インサラウム$$.
However, in the world where the $$破界の王$$ appeared, he lost in battle and received a scar on one cheek. Furthermore, so as not to forget the pain of losing his wife and children, he came to scar the other cheek with his own hand as well.

スコート・ラボ: Jigoku wrote 'Scoat Lab', but the Jigoku glossary corrected Traia's name to 'Scott' on verification, so I proposed 'Scott Lab'. 超時空物理学 keeps Jigoku's 'hyperspace physics', while 超時空修復 is a new token proposed as 'Hyperspacetime Repair' (kw_000 wrote 'hyperspacetime restoration' in plain text and 'hyperspacetime physics'). 時空修復 (Jigoku token, Spacetime Repair) is used where the Japanese has 時空修復 alone (511, 527, 528).

クロノ改革派 / 保守派: for 510, 523, 524, 525, 529 I kept Jigoku's 'Chrono Reform Faction' / 'Chrono Conservative Faction', while kw_000 used 'Reformists' / 'Conservatives'. 『人類の進化を監視する者』 (King, monitor) and 『見守る者』 (Advent, watch over) both stay 'the watchers over humanity's evolution' as in Jigoku, so kw_000's distinction (monitor vs watch over) is lost in 525/526.

御使い: kept as the kw_000 token (Envoy) and written as $$御使い$$s for the group of four; singular where the source names one (a $$御使い$$). Whether the token reads well in the plural needs the final English. 根源的災厄 is plain 'the fundamental calamity' as in kw_000 (Jigoku wrote Baal for it in one entry; バアル is a separate token in 509 and 517 where the Japanese says バアル).

「消滅しようとする力」 / 「存在しようとする力」 (508, 509, 511): plain quoted phrases 'force that seeks to vanish' / 'force that seeks to exist'. 永遠 (511, 505, 514) is rendered 'eternity' / 'four eternities'. 源理 (512, 513) is read as オリジン・ロー ('the power of Origin Law (that is, Dimensional Power)') because kw_000 gives オリジン・ロー as another name of 次元力. 三神器 = 'three sacred treasures'. 因果地平 = 'causal horizon'.
